rv.q: Christopher Pazdernik and his cast are very imaginative, very funny, and very silly.
Those are the messages of "Godspell," delivered with joy by this cast of friends to show you how to build a beautiful city of light and hope.
For those who are fans of the original Godspell, or just those who are looking for an upbeat musical, this production would be a good fit for you.

Their current production "Godspell" conceived by John-Michael Tebelak with music and lyrics by Stephen Schwartz ,directed to perfection by Christopher Pazdernik. is an amazing version of this musical piece.
